text: Forest has a beautiful design and a useful timer that genuinely blocks other apps, but the gamification feels at odds with the purpose of a focus app. Daily rewards, unlocks and digital collectibles use FOMO to nudge you back. This is not removed with the paid version. If you are trying to reduce phone use and increase your focus, an app should help you put your phone down, not use the same psychological techniques as games and social media. Choose a simpler, privacy-friendly focus app instead.
